result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming an aspect no longer stops the export. I only compiled the `reports` module (it builds cleanly). I didn't run any tests or an actual export, so the renamed-aspect case and the default entry order are untested.

In `DataExporter.java`, the hardcoded `aspect_*.txt` literals are gone. The code now builds the list of five scope aspects (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other). It gets each file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same method that writes the loose files. It then reads each file from `data/text` under that name and zips it with that name, in the same order as before.

With the default config the entries stay `aspect_main.txt` through `aspect_other.txt`. With the renamed aspect, `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt` goes in fourth place. `git-history.zip` is written again, since the missing-file exception no longer aborts the export before that step.
